mapper.select:
SELECT id AS sourceId,serial_number AS name FROM product_bom_info WHERE state=#{state} AND is_deleted = FALSE
AND serial_number ILIKE concat('%',#{searchKeyword}::text,'%')

select distinct pbi.id as bomId, pd.images_url as imagesUrl, pd.name as skuName, pd.id as skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pi.id as productId, pi.spu_no as spuNo, pd.status, pi.category, pi.brand_name as brandName, pbi.bom_version as bomVersion, pd.variant_property as variantProperty, pp.main_supplier as supplierId from product_bom_info pbi inner join product_bom_sku pbs on pbi.id = pbs.bom_id and pbs.is_deleted = false left join product_detail pd on pbs.parent_sku_no = pd.sku_no and pd.is_deleted = false left join product_info pi on pd.product_id = pi.id and pi.is_deleted = false left join product_purchase pp on pd.id = pp.sku_id and pp.is_deleted = false
pbi.is_deleted = false and pbi.state = 4
and pd.sku_no in
#{item}
AND pd.sku_no ILIKE concat('%',#{params.remoteSearchSku}::text,'%')
and pi.category_id in
#{item}
order by pbi.id desc

select pbi.id as bomId, pd.images_url as imagesUrl, pd.name as skuName, pd.id as skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pi.id as productId, pi.spu_no as spuNo, pd.status, pi.category, pi.brand_name as brandName, pbi.bom_version as bomVersion, pbs.quantity, pd.variant_property as variantProperty, pp.main_supplier as supplierId from product_bom_info pbi inner join product_bom_sku pbs on pbi.id = pbs.bom_id and pbs.is_deleted = false left join product_detail pd on pbs.sku_no = pd.sku_no and pd.is_deleted = false left join product_info pi on pd.product_id = pi.id and pi.is_deleted = false left join product_purchase pp on pd.id = pp.sku_id and pp.is_deleted = false
pbi.is_deleted = false and pbi.state = 4
and pbi.id in
#{item}

select pbi.id as bomId, pbs.id as detailId, pbs.parent_sku_no as parentSkuNo, pd.name, pbs.quantity as qty, pbs.sku_id as childSkuId, cpd.sku_no as childSkuNo, 0 as actualTaxCost, COALESCE(pc.target_tax_cost,0) as targetTaxCost, pbi.update_user_name as updateUserName, pbi.update_time as updateTime, pp.main_supplier as mainSupplierId from product_bom_info pbi inner join product_bom_sku pbs on pbi.id = pbs.bom_id and pbs.is_deleted = false left join product_detail pd on pbs.parent_sku_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false left join product_detail cpd on pbs.sku_id = cpd.id and cpd.is_deleted = false left join product_cost pc on cpd.id = pc.sku_id and pc.is_deleted = false left join product_purchase pp on cpd.id = pp.sku_id and pp.is_deleted = false
pbi.is_deleted = false and pbi.source_type = 'productCombination'
and pbs.parent_sku_no iLIKE concat('%', #{params.skuNo}::text,'%')
and pbs.sku_no iLIKE concat('%', #{params.childSkuNo}::text,'%')
and pd.name iLIKE concat('%', #{params.name}::text,'%')
and pbi.update_user_id in
#{item}
and pbi.update_time >= #{params.updateTimeList[0]} and (#{params.updateTimeList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > pbi.update_time
order by pbi.update_time desc, pbi.id desc
